title: Dragonfish's Scroll Racks
description: Changes the texture of bookshelves and chiseled bookshelves to make them look like scroll racks.
body: Changes the texture of bookshelves and chiseled bookshelves to make them look like scroll racks. Does not change anything else. Works best with the Dragonspeak resource pack for Wings of Fire: The New World (Not mine, not on Modrinth)
